cause.what_happened: SWMR gapped up 2.3% and then fell about 12.4% intraday to $16.29 at 15:04 ET on 2.9x normal dollar volume. This is the second straight double-digit down day (-12.3% on 09-28). EDGAR shows no filing after the 09-25 PREM14A, and no issuer release after 09-23. The most likely driver is continued selling of the roughly 9.35M shares (about 59% of the stock) released at the mid-September lock-up expiry, plus the Lucid equity line, but no document ties either one to today.

findings.finding: The Lucid Capital Markets equity line has been effective again since 2026-09-18 and can sell stock on 2026-09-30. About 2.35M of its 3.0M registered shares remain (roughly 14% of shares outstanding), at 98% of VWAP, capped at 250,000 shares or 20% of volume per purchase.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The registration went effective on 2026-09-18 (EFFECT), and the issuer has already used the line: 654,734 shares for $27.2M. Nothing more has to happen for it to sell stock into the 09-30 session, so this supply sits inside the window rather than after it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The line was re-registered on 09-16 and 09-18. The stock fell 28.36% on 09-15, rose 8.98% on 09-16, and has fallen on most sessions since. No draw has been dated to a specific session, so no clean reaction to an individual draw is observable.
findings.why_not_priced: The price has already fallen 45% in 20 sessions, but a live line that sells up to 250k shares into any session at 98% of VWAP caps a bounce mechanically. It is recurring supply rather than a one-off event, so the close cannot fully discount it. If the price held it, a 2.3% gap-up would not have turned into a 12% intraday fall on a day with no news.
findings.independence: The post-lock-up overhang from separate filings points the same way.
